name: daum-search
description: 다음 웹문서·동영상·이미지·블로그·책·카페 검색 (네이버가 종료한 책, 네이버에 없는 동영상 포함) — 다음(Daum) 검색 API. 웹문서·동영상·이미지·블로그·책·카페 검색. naver-search 와 같은 필드 이름(title/link/description/datetime)으로 돌려주므로 두 벤더를 바꿔 껴도 소비처가 그대로입니다. **책 검색은 네이버가 2026-07-31 에 종료해서 여기가 유일한 경로**이고, **동영상 검색은 네이버에 아예 없습니다**. 뉴스 검색은 다음에 없으니 뉴스는 naver-search 를 쓰십시오. 지역·장소 검색은 kakao-map 소관입니다. 인증 = kakao-map·kakao-talk 이 이미 쓰는 KAKAO_REST_API_KEY 그대로. 일 쿼터 = 검색 유형당 30,000건, 다음 검색 전체 50,000건.

actions.name: 다음 검색 (웹문서·동영상·이미지·블로그·책·카페)
actions.description: One endpoint per `type`, returning title / link / description / datetime plus per-type extras — the same field names naver-search uses, so rows from either vendor share a table. Book search is the notable one: Naver retired theirs on 2026-07-31 and this still answers, with ISBN / publisher / author narrowing via `target`. Video search has no Naver counterpart at all. Paging caps and sort words differ per type and are handled here: `recency` and `latest` mean the same thing but only one is valid per type, so the wrong one is translated rather than refused.

params.query: Search term, required. For blog, 'blogUrl term' (space separated) searches inside one blog
params.type: web | vclip (video) | image | blog | book | cafe
params.sort: accuracy (default) or newest-first — recency for every type except book, which calls it latest
params.page: Page number. 1-50, except video which stops at 15
params.size: Results per page. web/blog/cafe/book 1-50 (default 10), video 1-30 (default 15), image 1-80 (default 80)
params.target: book only: narrow to title | isbn | publisher | person

query.description: Search term. For blog search, a blog URL followed by a space and the term restricts the search to that blog

type.description: web=web documents, vclip=video (YouTube and others), image, blog=Daum blogs, book=book catalogue with ISBN/publisher/author, cafe=Daum cafe posts. Naver has no video search and retired book search on 2026-07-31; Daum has no news search

sort.description: accuracy (default) or newest-first. Newest-first is `recency` on web/vclip/image/blog/cafe and `latest` on book — the same idea under two names, and the wrong one for the type is translated rather than refused

page.description: Page number. 1-50 for all types except vclip, which caps at 15. Paging past `pageableTotal` returns nothing regardless

size.description: Results per page, and both the cap and the default vary: web/blog/cafe/book allow 50 and default to 10, vclip allows 30 and defaults to 15, image allows 80 and defaults to 80

target.description: [type=book] Narrow the match to one field. Ignored by every other type

pageableTotal.description: Documents actually reachable by paging — far smaller than `total` (the vendor's own example shows 775 against 897,323). This is the number to quote, and paging past it returns nothing

isEnd.description: Whether this is the last page

title.description: Absent for image results, which have no title

link.description: Document URL; for images, the image URL itself (the page holding it is `docLink`)

description.description: Excerpt, with the vendor's <b> match markers removed

items.description: Results. Extras by type: vclip adds thumbnail/playTimeSec/author, blog adds blogname/thumbnail, cafe adds cafename/thumbnail, image adds thumbnail/width/height/sitename/docLink/collection, book adds authors/translators/publisher/isbn/price/salePrice/thumbnail/status
